semiconductor_relevance: High — MMP CO., LTD. supplies critical components such as pipes, fittings, and valves specifically for the semiconductor and chemical industries.
summary: MMP CO., LTD. is a leading distributor of thermoplastic piping solutions, including CLEAN, HT, CPVC, PVC SCH80, PP, and PVDF materials, tailored for the semiconductor market. The company also offers automatic socket fusion machines for welding applications, ensuring high-quality connections in semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Distribution of CLEAN, HT, CPVC, PVC SCH80, PP, PVDF pipes and fittings
Supply of valves and automatic valves for semiconductor applications
Development of automatic socket fusion machines for PVC welding
